content.title: Chapter 78 - PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS — Sec. 78-129. - Temporary sewer connections.
content.summary:
Temporary connections may be made with any sewer from property lying without the district
               with the consent of the council and upon such terms as it may require.
(Code 1981, § 27-129; Ord. No. 551, § 70, 5-14-1964)
